submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gas gap provides the best time resolution (1.260 ns) among all environmentally compliant configurations. Mixture-G1, while offering superior time resolution at 2 mm (0.9 ns from earlier simulations), is excluded because its GWP100 of 1400 greatly exceeds the laboratory's mandatory environmental policy limit of 150. Mixture-G3, though having excellent environmental credentials (GWP100 = 15), exhibits significantly worse time resolution (minimum 2.019 ns at 1.5 mm gap). The 2.0 mm gap for Mixture-G2 was found to be optimal after testing gaps from 1.0 to 3.0 mm, showing a clear minimum in the time resolution curve at this value.

requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is listed as one of the three candidate mixtures in candidate_specs.md

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 has GWP100 = 120, which is below the 150 limit according to environmental_safety_review.md
Recommended gap of 2.0 mm is within the 1-3 mm range

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Among environmentally compliant mixtures, Mixture-G2 at 2.0 mm achieves 1.260 ns, which is the best time resolution. Mixture-G1 would offer better performance (0.9 ns) but violates the mandatory GWP100 constraint. Mixture-G3 best case is 2.019 ns, significantly worse than Mixture-G2.
